title: Flow Selection Bounds Align
description: Add bounding rectangle to flow display with alignment buttons on top (left align, vertical equal spacing, right align) and right side (top align, horizontal equal spacing, bottom align).
summary: Reorganized selection bounds overlay: top row now has align left, align horizontal (center x), align right; right column has align top, align vertical (center y), align bottom. Distribute vertical moved to left edge center; distribute horizontal moved to bottom edge center (shown only when 3+ selected). Added alignHorizontal and alignVertical modes in DagHost align_selection (centers nodes on union bounds). Updated hit regions, overlay UI, and tests.
